blocks.label: Empty state
blocks.title: Listening.
blocks.text: Suggestions appear here as the interview unfolds.

msgs.what: The interviewer opens the live session page. The Copilot panel is the first thing in the right column, above Speakers and Scores.
The existing dashboard websocket. The panel listens on it for four new message types: `copilot_card`, `copilot_coverage`, `scorecard`, `copilot_reply`.
The production factory reads `settings.peer_interviewer_enabled` (env `INTERVIEW_PILOT_PEER_INTERVIEWER_ENABLED`). When on, it passes a 30 s tick interval; otherwise 0.
msgs.code:
LangGraphSessionPipeline(
  session_id, failover, checkpointer,
  tick_interval_s=30.0 if settings.peer_interviewer_enabled else 0.0,
)

msgs.what: The graph gains nodes `coach_interviewer`, `suggest_probes`, `verify_claim`, `draft_clarification`, `suggest_edge_cases`, and the analysis prompt now lists the four peer actions it may choose. Peer mode uses the fan-out shape even when `AGENTIC_ROUTING_ENABLED` is off.
An asyncio task named `session-ticks:{session}` sleeps 30 s and enqueues `Tick(at=now)` while the pipeline runs. It is started with the consumer and cancelled on close.
Nothing has arrived yet. Coverage, scorecard and the ask box appear once their first payload lands.
